description: Get the timer that is currently running for a user (defaults to the token owner). Returns the active entry or empty if no timer is running. Use to check whether a timer is on before starting/stopping.

assignee.description: User id to check. Omit to check the token owner's running timer.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: get_running_time_entry
